e2e_tests.failure_reason: Visual snapshot regression — 40 tests comparing page screenshots to baseline snapshots failed due to layout/content changes in Wave 7 deliverables. Snapshots need refresh.

reason: E2E visual snapshot tests failed. Per commit-batch protocol: 'If any fail, write tail to report and STOP without committing.' Wave 7 deliverables (modular builder, 28 weapons, 23 missions, a11y fixes) have changed page layouts/content, invalidating visual regression baselines.
